purpose: Compare allocation methods on published reference factors, not certify executable profits or agent discoveries
median_windows: 36 consecutive months, ending every 12 months backwards from the final training month
covariance: Ledoit-Wolf linear shrinkage toward scaled identity
coefficients: nonnegative; no fixed strategy count; sum <= 1; no coefficient leverage; cash permitted
risk_limit: 10% estimated annual volatility; reduce exposure only, never increase leverage
selection: optimizer may give zero weight; all-cash if no positive estimated net training edge
cost_basis: sensitivity assumptions, not observed underlying stock turnover/borrow costs; switching charge on absolute coefficient trades, ongoing drag on invested factor coefficients
return_basis: synthetic funded account: French RF once plus weighted published self-financing factor returns, minus declared proxy costs; weights are reference sleeve coefficients, not qualified stock gross exposures
evaluation: report all 9 policy/scenario combinations and all 5 standalone references; no automatic winner selection
uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap, seed 404, 1999 draws, 12-month blocks; exploratory intervals, not admission tests
controls: known-process complementarity, duplicate invariance, negative-edge cash, prior-only decisions, row/column invariance, missing-input rejection, accounting identity, fresh-process reproduction
limitations: post-publication 2016-2020 slice reported separately, not untouched evidence
